Name: Sebastian Immersive Wedding
Author: Elaho
Description:
[quote][size=4]**APRIL 25, 2024:

[b]THIS MOD IS CURRENTLY BROKEN IN STARDEW 1.6!! Sebastian Immersive Wedding [and all other immersive wedding mods] are NOT compatible with the latest 1.6 update.[/b]
[/size]
But!! The latest version is expected to be launched in Summer 2024. I'll be updating pages on this mod, including the Changelogs and Decription  [Warning: Spoilers!] as the transition takes place. In the meantime, follow my [url=http://elaho.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url]﻿ for more details and sneak peeks for what's to come. 

Thank you all for your patience and continued support  :)

-Elaho[/quote]


[b]**CONTENT WARNING: This mod contains references to neglect/abuse, parental abandonment, depression, toxic family dynamics, trauma, substance abuse, and coarse language**[/b]

This mod is for players who want a more challenging wedding route, or for players who want a more immersive engagement period and wedding ceremony with Sebastian. Ever wonder what your spouse is doing during those three days of wedding planning?

This mod features a closer look at the details of your wedding with Sebastian and includes:

-       Your choice of a spouse-based personalized ceremony (10,000g)
-       Wedding planning and coordination event with Lewis
-       A special engagement gift event with Sebastian**[b](CONTENT WARNING)[/b]** [b](THIS EVENT IS OPTIONAL)[/b]

Sebastian’s wedding arch and decoration designs are based on my other mod “[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10903]Sebastian Wedding Outfits[/url]”, though the current décor leans more towards Sebastian’s interests and Romanian outfit/background than Dutch or Vietnamese.  However, the wedding décor is available regardless of which outfit Sebastian is configured to wear at the ceremony. 

The main feature of the ceremony includes a coffin-shaped arch with black and red flowers (matching his Romanian regalia), along with slight seasonal variations based on Sebastian’s personality and preferences.

*All wedding décor is compatible with both Vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded town maps. *

[b]-----------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

[b][size=5]How to use this mod (light spoilers):[/size]
[/b]
[b][size=4]Part 1: Pre-engagement:
[/size][/b]
-       Upgrade House to level 1 (needed for marriage)
-       Purchase Mermaid Pendant and give to Sebastian.

[b][size=4]Part 2: Engagement (3 days):[/size][/b]
[b]
Day 1:[/b] The same day you give Sebastian the Mermaid’s Pendant, make sure you have at least [b]10,000g [/b]available before you go to sleep. You will need this to trigger Mayor Lewis’ event regarding wedding decorations.

[b]Day 2:[/b] Mayor Lewis will appear at your front door and give you the option between two different ceremony types (fancy 10,000g or standard vanilla). If you choose the 10,000g ceremony, Mayor Lewis will deduct the funds and give you the “Crystal Skull” crafting recipe. An invoice for wedding expenses will also appear in the mail the following day (optional). *You must have seen this event( and go to sleep) before the Day 3 event is available. *

[b]Day 3 (*optional*) (**CONTENT WARNING**): [/b]Go to the mountain between 8 PM and 12 AM. Make sure you have a Crystal Skull in your inventory. You will receive a special engagement event with Sebastian. This is completely optional and will not impact your wedding ceremony.

(*Players [b]MUST[/b] have seen Sebastian's 10-heart event for this event to trigger*)

([b]**Content Warning**[/b]: This event contains references to neglect/abuse, parental abandonment, depression, toxic family dynamics, trauma, substance abuse, and coarse language. If you’re not in a good head space or don’t want to see this event, you can press the SKIP button, choose not to give the Crystal Skull to Sebastian during the event, or not have the Crystal Skull in your inventory.)

[b][size=4]Part 3: Wedding Day:[/size]
[/b]
[b]Event 1 (Marriage Ceremony):[/b] The marriage ceremony will commence as normal in the Town Square at 6 AM but with your
chosen décor.
 
[b]*NEW* Additional Features:
[/b]
[b]New Portrait:[/b] During the Pre-Wedding Event (optional), Sebastian will have a new portrait. This portrait is compatible with different outfits for Sebastian, but portraits must be in the Vanilla style to display properly. 

[b]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

[b][size=4]Mod Requirements:[/size][/b]
-       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
-       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
-       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
-       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]
-       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10747]SAAT- Audio API and Toolkit[/url]

[b][size=4]Mod Pairings[/size][/b] (optional, but highly recommended):
-       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11446]Paisley’s Bridal Boutique (GMM)[/url]
-       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2072]Dynamic Night Time[/url] (*This mod is NOT recommended for the winter wedding, as it makes the ceremony too dark to see)
-       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3312]MissCoriel's Unique Courtship Responses[/url]
-       [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10903]Sebastian Wedding Outfits[/url]

[b]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

[b][size=4]Tips and Recommendations:[/size]
[/b]
1. The Fossilized Skull can be found on Ginger Island in the Dig Site next to Professor Snails’ tent, but it can also appear in Golden Coconuts when cracked open by Clint. It is recommended that you have at least 1 Fossilized Skull before proposing to Sebastian.

2.  The total amount leading up to your wedding (Including: House Upgrade 1, Mermaid’s Pendant, and Personalized Ceremony) is [b]25,000g[/b]. This excludes any wedding outfits from Paisley’s Bridal Boutique and any items required for the Crystal Skull. It is highly recommended you have a fair bit of money saved up (before proposing) to cover all expenses.

3.  Sebastian’s engagement event (optional) is only available [b]1 day[/b] before your wedding. You MUST trigger the event during this period, as it will [b]not[/b] happen after you are married. Because of this, it is highly recommended that you have all items needed to craft the Crystal Skull before you propose to Sebastian (1 Fossilized Skull, 25 Frozen Tears, 50 Slime). 

[b][size=4]Some Background about this Mod:[/size]
[/b]
Sebastian is an [url=https://www.16personalities.com/intp-personality]INTP[/url] who is reserved, morose, and blunt, but also incredibly pensive, thoughtful, and – despite his best efforts to hide it- sensitive and caring.

In the beginning, Sebastian comes across as your typical Emo/goth boy who enjoys darkness, isolation, and cryptic communication. But, as we spend more time with Sebastian throughout the game, we see that his ‘loner’ lifestyle isn’t necessarily something he chose for himself – but rather, it was a self-preservation tactic he adopted to survive his family’s toxic dynamic.

Throughout your friendship, we see Sebastian reveal more about his family, his life, and past childhood experiences. Once you’re married to him, we do get to see Sebastian slightly more affectionate with the farmer in his dialogue; however, we don’t get to see how Sebastian’s relationship with the farmer influenced any significant (positive) change in his life or see him open up to the farmer in a meaningfully emotional or vulnerable way. And because we don’t get to see that transformation in-game, unfortunately, the relationship Sebastian has with the farmer often comes across as a co-dependent partnership rather than a healthy, mutually beneficial one.

With this mod, I wanted to delve deeper into Sebastian’s character and explore his journey of self-discovery and personal growth throughout his relationship with the farmer (regardless of whether you decided to marry him or not). Though this mod does go into some dark territory, I believe Sebastian’s story is something a lot of people can relate to and have experienced to some degree in their lives [myself included]. There is no magic fix for the complex family problems many of us were born into, and it can be discouraging when (well-meaning) friends or acquaintances insist that there is. It can often feel like we’re alone in our suffering or that no one can understand what we’re going through.

But we’re not alone. And we don’t have to go through our healing journey alone, either.

We may not get to choose our parents or our childhoods, but we can choose how we respond to them. When we do, we start taking control of our own lives, find empowerment and responsibility in our own choices, and develop the support network that we need, so that we can create the kind of life we want and deserve for ourselves. It's never an easy journey, but it is a worthwhile one. And for Sebastian, facing his painful childhood and upbringing, including the absence of his biological father, is a hard but necessary step in creating the kind of life he wants for himself – one with the farmer by his side, forever. 

[b]---------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

[b][size=4]The Future of this Mod:[/size]
[/b]
This is a continuation of my cultural wedding mod series, with a more detailed and intimate engagement and wedding experience with Sebastian. My goal is to continue to add more events for players to experience down the line, including:

-       Bachelor/Bachelorette party for the player
-       A potential honeymoon event (at Ginger Island?Maybe?)
-       Wedding Reception hosted by Gus
-       Post-ceremony and Post-reception events
-       Potential Vietnamese-inspired wedding décor for Dutch-Vietnamese-Sebastian

I do have plans for creating immersive wedding mods for the other marriage candidates, but it will be at my own pace and in my own time.

[b]Q: Is this mod available in any other languages?[/b]
A: As of right now, this mod is only available in English. However, translations are welcome and will be implemented in updated versions of this mod (with translation credit).  

[b]**PLEASE NOTE (IMPORTANT!!)**
[size=3]
[/size][/b][size=3] Requests for other marriage candidates/NPCs are [b]NOT[/b] being accepted.
[/size]
Any messages or PMs requesting mods for other characters will be ignored and/or deleted. Repeat offenders will be given a final warning and subsequently banned if they ask again. This may seem harsh, but this project is something I’ve been doing for free in my spare time, and receiving a bombardment of requests is incredibly stressful.

Polite mod suggestions are welcome, but requests are not.

Commissions for other characters/NPCs MAY be accepted but will be very expensive (USD 300+).
